_: THE PER-PAGE CALL BUDGET OF A FIRM'S HOME (l16 firmhome, Fable round 2 R2-1). One load of Home, signed in as a firm (clients by live grants, no trade of its own), makes at most this many /api calls, counted by e2e/walk-firm-practice.cjs at 1366 and 390. The api's limiter is 500 per 900 s: the ninth return to Home inside 15 minutes was refused at 58 calls a load. Raising it needs the reason in the PR and cb-speed's yes; the fix is to ask for less, not to raise the number.
